description: The navaid kinds by NASR's NAV_BASE NAV_TYPE, one copy for every reader: `vor`, the navaids the sectional draws as a VOR (the VOR's hexagon, the VOR/DME's in its box and the VORTAC's; FAA Aeronautical Chart User's Guide, VFR Terms and Symbols, Radio Aids to Navigation), and `navaid`, every kind a route may fly over, in the order one is kept over another of the same ident (not the VOR test facilities, VOT, the fan markers or a marine beacon, which no route flies to).

navaid.description: Every kind a route flies over, the likelier to fly to first.
